scope: 2022 six preselected JRA turf G1 races, newly added external generalization checks; one race per distance, no exclusion by residual

positionProxyDefinition.groups: use each horse own reported rank; parallel-group bounds are preserved as category ambiguity, without inventing intra-group ordering

measurementCaveats: JRA times and individual last600 are displayed to 0.1 seconds.
Leader 200m sectionals may refer to different horses; they are not the winner complete speed path.
Within1/2-second denominators are finishers; DNF remains in starter counts.
Six different events/course/populations confound distance; one race per distance cannot set style probability targets.
2022 Kikuka3000 and TennoSpring3200 are Hanshin, not Kyoto; Spring official outer-to-inner mixed route is still a proxy.
Photo head/nose/neck margins retained raw, never mapped to invented length values.
